title: My Family
story_description: A student shows a family photo to a friend.
story_intro: Two friends are sitting together.
One student has a photo in her hand.
It is a photo of her family.
She introduces each person in the photo.
They talk about how many people are in their families.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你看！這是我家的照片。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ kàn! zhè shì wǒ jiā de zhào piàn.
dialogue.en: Mark, look! This is a photo of my family.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 哇，這張照片很漂亮。這是你爸爸和媽媽嗎？
dialogue.py: wa, zhè zhāng zhào piàn hěn piào liang. zhè shì nǐ bà ba hé mā ma ma?
dialogue.en: Wow, this photo is beautiful. Are these your father and mother?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 對，這是我爸爸，這是我媽媽。
dialogue.py: duì, zhè shì wǒ bà ba, zhè shì wǒ mā ma.
dialogue.en: Yes, this is my father, and this is my mother.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 他們看起來很年輕。
dialogue.py: tā men kàn qǐ lái hěn nián qīng.
dialogue.en: They look very young.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。這是我哥哥，這是我妹妹。
dialogue.py: xiè xie. zhè shì wǒ gē ge, zhè shì wǒ mèi mei.
dialogue.en: Thanks. This is my older brother, and this is my younger sister.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你有兄弟姐妹嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ yǒu xiōng dì jiě mèi ma?
dialogue.en: Do you have siblings?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 有，一個哥哥和一個妹妹。你呢？
dialogue.py: yǒu, yī gè gē ge hé yī gè mèi mei. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: Yes, one older brother and one younger sister. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我沒有兄弟姐妹，我是獨生子。
dialogue.py: wǒ méi yǒu xiōng dì jiě mèi, wǒ shì dú shēng zǐ.
dialogue.en: I don't have siblings, I am an only child.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 喔，那你家有幾口人？
dialogue.py: ō, nà nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
dialogue.en: Oh, then how many people are in your family?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我家有三口人：爸爸、媽媽和我。
dialogue.py: wǒ jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén: bà ba, mā ma hé wǒ.
dialogue.en: There are three people in my family: father, mother, and me.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我家有五口人。我們家很大。
dialogue.py: wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. wǒ men jiā hěn dà.
dialogue.en: There are five people in my family. Our family is big.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 真好！
dialogue.py: zhēn hǎo!
dialogue.en: That's great!

key_sentences.en: Are these your father and mother?
How many people in your family?

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Show an imaginary photo to your friend. Introduce your family members and ask about their family size.

comprehension.q: What is A showing to Mark?
How many siblings does A have?
Is Mark an only child?
How many people are in A's family?
How many people are in Mark's family?

true_false.q: There are five people in A's family.
A and Mark are talking about a photo.

passage.title: My Family Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克，你看！這是我家的照片。哇，這張照片很漂亮。這是你爸爸和媽媽嗎？對，這是我爸爸，這是我媽媽。他們看起來很年輕。謝謝。這是我哥哥，這是我妹妹。
passage.en: Two friends are sitting together. One student has a photo in her hand. It is a photo of her family. She introduces each person in the photo. They talk about how many people are in their families.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write 5 sentences about your family (e.g., 'My family has 4 people', 'I have a brother').

grammar.explanation: Using '口 (kǒu)' as a measure word for family members. Using '有 (yǒu)' for possession ('have') and '沒有 (méi yǒu)' for 'don't have'.
examples: 我有哥哥。 (I have an older brother.)
我沒有弟弟。 (I don't have a younger brother.)
你家有幾口人？ (How many people are in your family?)
我家有三口人。 (My family has three people.)
這是我爸爸。 (This is my father.)

practice.q: Translate: I don't have a brother.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè shì nǐ jiě jie ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Is this your older sister?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.py: bù, zhè shì wǒ hǎo péng you.
expansion_dialogue.en: No, this is my good friend.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.py: tā zhēn piào liang.
expansion_dialogue.en: She is really beautiful.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 謝謝，她也是我們班的學生。
expansion_dialogue.py: xiè xie, tā yě shì wǒ men bān de xué sheng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Thanks, she is also a student in our class.

review.speaking: Introduce your family size and members.
review.self_check: Can you name your family members and say how many people are in your family?

title: My Friend
story_description: A student describes their best friend to another classmate.
story_intro: Two students are talking during a break.
One student asks about the other's friends.
A student describes his best friend.
He talks about his friend's name, nationality, and personality.
They talk about what they do together.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你有很多朋友嗎？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ yǒu hěn duō péng you ma?
dialogue.en: Mark, do you have many friends?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有，我在這裡認識了很多新朋友。
dialogue.py: yǒu, wǒ zài zhè lǐ rèn shi le hěn duō xīn péng you.
dialogue.en: Yes, I've met many new friends here.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 誰是你最好的朋友？
dialogue.py: shéi shì nǐ zuì hǎo de péng you?
dialogue.en: Who is your best friend?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我最好的朋友叫大衛。
dialogue.py: wǒ zuì hǎo de péng you jiào dà wèi.
dialogue.en: My best friend is called David.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 大衛是哪國人？
dialogue.py: dà wèi shì nǎ guó rén?
dialogue.en: What nationality is David?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 他是加拿大人。我們一起學中文。
dialogue.py: tā shì jiā ná dà rén. wǒ men yī qǐ xué zhōng wén.
dialogue.en: He is Canadian. We study Chinese together.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 他是一個怎麼樣的人？
dialogue.py: tā shì yī gè zěn me yàng de rén?
dialogue.en: What kind of person is he?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 他非常聰明，也很幽默。
dialogue.py: tā fēi cháng cōng ming, yě hěn yōu mò.
dialogue.en: He is very smart and also very humorous.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你們常在一起做什麼？
dialogue.py: nǐ men cháng zài yī qǐ zuò shén me?
dialogue.en: What do you usually do together?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我們常一起打籃球，或者去圖書館看書。
dialogue.py: wǒ men cháng yī qǐ dǎ lán qiú, huò zhě qù tú shū guǎn kàn shū.
dialogue.en: We often play basketball together, or go to the library to read.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很不錯。
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái hěn bù cuò.
dialogue.en: Sounds good.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 下次我介紹你們認識。
dialogue.py: xià cì wǒ jiè shào nǐ men rèn shi.
dialogue.en: I'll introduce you to each other next time.

key_sentences.en: My best friend is named David.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Describe your best friend to a new classmate. Tell their name, where they are from, and one thing you do together.

comprehension.q: How many friends has Mark met here?
What is the name of Mark's best friend?
What nationality is David?
What two adjectives describe David's personality?
Where do they sometimes go to read books?

true_false.q: David and Mark study Chinese together.

passage.title: My Friend Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克，你有很多朋友嗎？有，我在這裡認識了很多新朋友。誰是你最好的朋友？我最好的朋友叫大衛。大衛是哪國人？
passage.en: Two students are talking during a break. One student asks about the other's friends. A student describes his best friend. He talks about his friend's name, nationality, and personality. They talk about what they do together.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a short profile of your best friend: name, age, nationality, and what they are like (personality).

grammar.explanation: Using '最 (zuì)' for superlative ('the most'). Adverb '非常 (fēi cháng)' for emphasis. Using '常 (cháng)' for frequency.
examples: 他常看電影。 (He often watches movies.)
我不常喝咖啡。 (I don't often drink coffee.)

practice.q: Complete: 他___聰明。 (He is extremely smart.)
Translate: I often go to the library.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ rèn shi dà wèi ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Do you know David?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 認識，他是我最好的朋友。
expansion_dialogue.py: rèn shi, tā shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péng you.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, he is my best friend.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.py: tā yě rèn shi wǒ mèi mei.
expansion_dialogue.en: He also knows my younger sister.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.py: zhēn de ma? tài qiǎo le!
expansion_dialogue.en: Really? What a coincidence!

review.speaking: Describe one friend's name and personality.
review.writing: Write a 5-sentence profile of a friend.
review.self_check: Can you describe a friend's name, nationality, and personality?

title: How Old Are You?
story_description: Students fill out a class profile form and ask each other ages.
story_intro: It is the first day of class.
The teacher gives the students a form.
They need to write their personal information.
They ask each other about their ages and birthdays.
They practice numbers and age-related questions.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 各位同學，請填寫這張表格。
dialogue.py: gè wèi tóng xué, qǐng tián xiě zhè zhāng biǎo gé.
dialogue.en: Class, please fill out this form.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 寫下你的姓名、國籍和年齡。
dialogue.py: xiě xià nǐ de xìng míng, guó jí hé nián líng.
dialogue.en: Write down your name, nationality, and age.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你今年幾歲？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ jīn nián jǐ suì?
dialogue.en: Mark, how old are you this year?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我今年二十歲。你呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ jīn nián èr shí suì. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: I am twenty years old this year. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我二十一歲。
dialogue.py: wǒ èr shí yī suì.
dialogue.en: I am twenty-one years old.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那你比我大一歲。
dialogue.py: nà nǐ bǐ wǒ dà yī suì.
dialogue.en: Then you are one year older than me.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 對。你的生日是幾月幾號？
dialogue.py: duì. nǐ de shēng rì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
dialogue.en: Right. When is your birthday (month and day)?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我的生日是十月五號。你呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ de shēng rì shì shí yuè wǔ hào. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: My birthday is October 5th. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我的生日是三月十二號。
dialogue.py: wǒ de shēng rì shì sān yuè shí èr hào.
dialogue.en: My birthday is March 12th.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我們班誰年齡最大？
dialogue.py: wǒ men bān shéi nián líng zuì dà?
dialogue.en: Who is the oldest in our class?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我覺得是大明，他二十五歲了。
dialogue.py: wǒ jué de shì dà míng, tā èr shí wǔ suì le.
dialogue.en: I think it's Daming, he is twenty-five years old.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 二十五歲？那他比我們都大。
dialogue.py: èr shí wǔ suì? nà tā bǐ wǒ men dōu dà.
dialogue.en: Twenty-five? Then he is older than all of us.

key_sentences.en: How old are you this year?
You are one year older than me.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are filling out a profile. Ask your partner their age and birthday. Compare your ages (who is older?).

comprehension.q: What are the students doing?
How old is Mark?
How old is the other student?
When is Mark's birthday?
Who is the oldest in the class according to A?

true_false.q: They are writing their names on a form.

passage.title: How Old Are You? Listening Passage
passage.zh: 各位同學，請填寫這張表格。寫下你的姓名、國籍和年齡。馬克，你今年幾歲？我今年二十歲。你呢？我二十一歲。
passage.en: It is the first day of class. The teacher gives the students a form. They need to write their personal information. They ask each other about their ages and birthdays. They practice numbers and age-related questions.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Complete a simple personal profile: Name, Country, Age, Birthday.

grammar.explanation: Asking age with '幾歲 (jǐ suì)' (for children/peers) or '多大 (duō dà)' (general). Comparison with 'A 比 B + Adjective'. Dates: 'Month + 月 + Day + 號'.
examples: 哥哥比我大。 (Older brother is older than me.)
我比他小。 (I am younger than him.)
我二十歲了。 (I am 20 years old now - 'le' for new status.)

practice.q: Complete: 他比我___。 (He is older than me.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ dì di jǐ suì?
expansion_dialogue.en: How old is your younger brother?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.py: tā jīn nián shí suì le.
expansion_dialogue.en: He is ten years old this year.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.py: tā de shēng rì kuài dào le ba?
expansion_dialogue.en: His birthday is coming soon, right?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.py: duì, shì xià gè xīng qī liù.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, it's next Saturday.

review.speaking: Ask '你幾歲？' and answer.
review.self_check: Can you say your age and birthday in Chinese?

title: My Birthday
story_description: A classmate invites another student to a small birthday party.
story_intro: A student's birthday is coming.
She wants to have a small party.
She invites her friend to her home.
They talk about the time and place.
They also talk about cake and gifts.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，下個星期六是我的生日。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, xià gè xīng qī liù shì wǒ de shēng rì.
dialogue.en: Mark, next Saturday is my birthday.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？祝你生日快樂！
dialogue.py: zhēn de ma? zhù nǐ shēng rì kuài lè!
dialogue.en: Really? Happy birthday!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。我星期六晚上想請朋友來我家玩。
dialogue.py: xiè xie. wǒ xīng qī liù wǎn shang xiǎng qǐng péng you lái wǒ jiā wán.
dialogue.en: Thanks. I want to invite friends to my house on Saturday night.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了！幾點開始？
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le! jǐ diǎn kāi shǐ?
dialogue.en: Great! What time does it start?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 晚上七點。你能來嗎？
dialogue.py: wǎn shang qī diǎn. nǐ néng lái ma?
dialogue.en: 7:00 PM. Can you come?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 能，我一定去。要做什麼準備嗎？
dialogue.py: néng, wǒ yī dìng qù. yào zuò shén me zhǔn bèi ma?
dialogue.en: Yes, I'll definitely go. Do I need to prepare anything?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 不用，我會準備蛋糕和飲料。
dialogue.py: bù yòng, wǒ huì zhǔn bèi dàn gāo hé yǐn liào.
dialogue.en: No need, I will prepare cake and drinks.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你喜歡什麼禮物？
dialogue.py: nǐ xǐ huan shén me lǐ wù?
dialogue.en: What kind of gift do you like?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 不用送禮物，你能來我就很高興了。
dialogue.py: bù yòng sòng lǐ wù, nǐ néng lái wǒ jiù hěn gāo xìng le.
dialogue.en: No need for gifts, I'm just happy if you can come.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我會帶點好吃的。
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, wǒ huì dài diǎn hǎo chī de.
dialogue.en: It's okay, I'll bring something delicious.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 那謝謝你。我們星期六晚上見！
dialogue.py: nà xiè xie nǐ. wǒ men xīng qī liù wǎn shang jiàn!
dialogue.en: Then thank you. See you Saturday night!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好，星期六見！
dialogue.py: hǎo, xīng qī liù jiàn!
dialogue.en: Okay, see you Saturday!

key_sentences.zh: 下個星期六是我的生日。

key_sentences.en: I want to invite friends to play.

vocabulary.meaning: to give (as a gift) / to deliver

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Invite your friend to your birthday party next Friday at 6:00 PM. Tell them not to bring a gift.

comprehension.q: When is A's birthday?
Where will the party be?
What time does the party start?
What will A prepare for the party?
What will Mark bring to the party?

true_false.q: Mark cannot go to the party.
A asked Mark to bring a cake.
A will be happy if Mark just comes.
Mark wants to give a gift.

passage.title: My Birthday Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克，下個星期六是我的生日。真的嗎？祝你生日快樂！謝謝。我星期六晚上想請朋友來我家玩。太好了！幾點開始？晚上七點。你能來嗎？
passage.en: A student's birthday is coming. She wants to have a small party. She invites her friend to her home. They talk about the time and place. They also talk about cake and gifts.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a birthday invitation: include date, time, place, and 'Please come!'.

grammar.explanation: Using '能 (néng)' for possibility/ability. Using '會 (huì)' for future intention. '請 (qǐng)' used as 'to invite someone to do something'.
examples: 請他吃飯。 (Invite him to eat.)

practice.q: Translate: Wish you a happy birthday!
Complete: 我___去你家。 (I will go...)
Translate: Invite a friend to play.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè shì sòng nǐ de lǐ wù.
expansion_dialogue.en: This is a gift for you.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.py: wa, shì yī běn shū! xiè xie nǐ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Wow, it's a book! Thank you.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.py: bù kè qì, xī wàng nǐ xǐ huan.
expansion_dialogue.en: You're welcome, I hope you like it.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan zhè běn shū.
expansion_dialogue.en: I like this book very much.

review.speaking: Invite a friend to a party.
review.self_check: Can you invite someone to a party and wish them happy birthday?

title: Colors in the Room
story_description: Students decorate the classroom and choose colors for posters.
story_intro: The students are making posters.
They have many colored pens and papers.
They talk about which colors they like.
They decide which colors to use for the posters.
The classroom becomes very colorful.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，我們來做海報吧。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, wǒ men lái zuò hǎi bào ba.
dialogue.en: Mark, let's make posters.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好啊。你這裡有很多顏色的筆。
dialogue.py: hǎo a. nǐ zhè lǐ yǒu hěn duō yán sè de bǐ.
dialogue.en: Sure. You have pens in many colors here.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 對。你喜歡什麼顏色？
dialogue.py: duì. nǐ xǐ huan shén me yán sè?
dialogue.en: Yes. What color do you like?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我最喜歡藍色。你呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan lán sè. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: I like blue the best. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我最喜歡紅色和黃色。
dialogue.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan hóng sè hé huáng sè.
dialogue.en: I like red and yellow the best.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那我們用藍色的紙做海報嗎？
dialogue.py: nà wǒ men yòng lán sè de zhǐ zuò hǎi bào ma?
dialogue.en: Then shall we use blue paper for the poster?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 可以。海報的字用什麼顏色？
dialogue.py: kě yǐ. hǎi bào de zì yòng shén me yán sè?
dialogue.en: Can do. What color for the poster's characters?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我覺得用黑色或者白色比較清楚。
dialogue.py: wǒ jué de yòng hēi sè huò zhě bái sè bǐ jiào qīng chu.
dialogue.en: I think using black or white is clearer.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 好主意。海報上面畫什麼？
dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì. hǎi bào shàng miàn huà shén me?
dialogue.en: Good idea. What shall we draw on the poster?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我們可以畫綠色的樹和紅色的花。
dialogue.py: wǒ men kě yǐ huà lǜ sè de shù hé hóng sè de huā.
dialogue.en: We can draw green trees and red flowers.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 太漂亮了！我們開始畫吧。
dialogue.py: tài piào liang le! wǒ men kāi shǐ huà ba.
dialogue.en: So beautiful! Let's start drawing.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好，我來畫樹。
dialogue.py: hǎo, wǒ lái huà shù.
dialogue.en: Okay, I'll draw the trees.

key_sentences.en: Use blue paper to make posters.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are choosing colors for a new shirt. Tell your friend your favorite color and ask their opinion on black vs. white.
part_c: 你今天穿什麼顏色的衣服？

Which color does Mark like best?
What two colors does A like best?
What colors are suggested for the text to make it clear?
What will they draw on the poster?

passage.title: Colors in the Room Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克，我們來做海報吧。好啊。你這裡有很多顏色的筆。對。你喜歡什麼顏色？我最喜歡藍色。你呢？我最喜歡紅色和黃色。
passage.en: The students are making posters. They have many colored pens and papers. They talk about which colors they like. They decide which colors to use for the posters. The classroom becomes very colorful.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Describe 5 colored objects you see in your room (e.g., 'The bed is white', 'The book is blue').

grammar.explanation: Using '比較 (bǐ jiào)' for relative comparison. Using '或者 (huò zhě)' for 'or' in statements. Color nouns end in '色 (sè)'.
examples: 喝茶或者咖啡。 (Drink tea or coffee.)
用藍色的筆 (Use a blue pen)

practice.q: Complete: 這本書___貴。 (This book is relatively expensive.)
Translate: Use a pen to write.

expansion_dialogue.en: Is this piece of clothing beautiful?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.en: Very beautiful, but I don't like yellow.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.en: Then how about this blue one?

expansion_dialogue.en: The blue one looks better.

title: Clothes Today
story_description: Two friends talk about what they are wearing today.
story_intro: It is a sunny day.
Two friends meet on the street.
They look at each other's clothes.
They talk about shirts, pants, and shoes.
They also talk about colors and style.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你今天穿得很帥！
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ jīn tiān chuān de hěn shuài!
dialogue.en: Mark, you are dressed very handsomely today!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。我穿了我的新襯衫。
dialogue.py: xiè xie. wǒ chuān le wǒ de xīn chèn shān.
dialogue.en: Thanks. I'm wearing my new shirt.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 這件襯衫的顏色很好看。
dialogue.py: zhè jiàn chèn shān de yán sè hěn hǎo kàn.
dialogue.en: The color of this shirt looks very good.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我也很喜歡。你今天的裙子也很漂亮。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě hěn xǐ huan. nǐ jīn tiān de qún zi yě hěn piào liang.
dialogue.en: I like it too. Your skirt today is also very beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 這是我的生日禮物。
dialogue.py: zhè shì wǒ de shēng rì lǐ wù.
dialogue.en: This was my birthday gift.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你的鞋子也是新的嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ de xié zi yě shì xīn de ma?
dialogue.en: Are your shoes new too?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 不是，這雙鞋子我穿了很久了。
dialogue.py: bù shì, zhè shuāng xié zi wǒ chuān le hěn jiǔ le.
dialogue.en: No, I've worn this pair of shoes for a long time.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 但是它們看起來很乾淨。
dialogue.py: dàn shì tā men kàn qǐ lái hěn gān jìng.
dialogue.en: But they look very clean.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 天氣變冷了，你沒穿夾克嗎？
dialogue.py: tiān qì biàn lěng le, nǐ méi chuān jiá kè ma?
dialogue.en: The weather has turned cold, aren't you wearing a jacket?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 夾克在我的書包裡。等一下我會穿上。
dialogue.py: jiá kè zài wǒ de shū bāo lǐ. děng yī xià wǒ huì chuān shàng.
dialogue.en: The jacket is in my schoolbag. I'll put it on in a moment.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 好，別感冒了。
dialogue.py: hǎo, bié gǎn mào le.
dialogue.en: Okay, don't catch a cold.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，謝謝提醒。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí, xiè xie tí xǐng.
dialogue.en: No problem, thanks for the reminder.

key_sentences.en: This pair of shoes has been worn for long.
The jacket is in the bag.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Compliment your friend's clothes. Ask if their shoes or shirt is new. Tell them the weather is cold.
part_c: 你今天穿什麼顏色的衣服？
你喜歡穿襯衫還是夾克？

comprehension.q: What is Mark wearing that is new?
Why is A wearing a beautiful skirt?
Has A worn her shoes for a long time or a short time?
Where is Mark's jacket?
How is the weather today?

true_false.q: Mark is wearing an old shirt.
Mark will put on his jacket soon.

passage.title: Clothes Today Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克，你今天穿得很帥！謝謝。我穿了我的新襯衫。這件襯衫的顏色很好看。我也很喜歡。你今天的裙子也很漂亮。這是我的生日禮物。
passage.en: It is a sunny day. Two friends meet on the street. They look at each other's clothes. They talk about shirts, pants, and shoes. They also talk about colors and style.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Describe what you are wearing today: include 3 items and their colors.

grammar.explanation: Using '得 (de)' to describe how an action is performed (e.g., '穿得帥'). Measure words for clothes: '件 (jiàn)' for tops, '雙 (shuāng)' for shoes.
examples: 一雙鞋子 (One pair of shoes)
變冷了 (Became cold - 'le' for change of state)

practice.q: Complete: 他穿___很漂亮。 (She dresses very beautifully.)
Complete: 夾克___書包裡。 (The jacket is in the bag.)

expansion_dialogue.en: Where are you going?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ qù mǎi yī fu.
expansion_dialogue.en: I'm going to buy clothes.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.en: What do you want to buy?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.en: I want to buy a pair of black pants.

review.speaking: Describe your clothes today.
review.self_check: Can you use '件' and '雙' correctly for clothing?

title: Food I Like
story_description: Students talk about favorite food during lunch break.
story_intro: It is lunch time.
Students are eating together.
They talk about different kinds of food.
They ask 'What do you like to eat?'.
They talk about fruit, meat, and vegetables.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你喜歡吃中國菜嗎？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ xǐ huan chī zhōng guó cài ma?
dialogue.en: Mark, do you like eating Chinese food?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 非常喜歡。我覺得中國菜很好吃。
dialogue.py: fēi cháng xǐ huan. wǒ jué de zhōng guó cài hěn hǎo chī.
dialogue.en: Very much. I think Chinese food is delicious.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你最喜歡吃什麼？
dialogue.py: nǐ zuì xǐ huan chī shén me?
dialogue.en: What do you like to eat the most?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我最喜歡吃米飯和牛肉。你呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan chī mǐ fàn hé niú ròu. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: I like eating rice and beef the most. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡吃麵條，也喜歡吃很多蔬菜。
dialogue.py: wǒ xǐ huan chī miàn tiáo, yě xǐ huan chī hěn duō shū cài.
dialogue.en: I like eating noodles, and I also like eating lots of vegetables.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你不喜歡吃肉嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ bù xǐ huan chī ròu ma?
dialogue.en: Don't you like eating meat?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我不常吃肉。我比較喜歡吃魚。
dialogue.py: wǒ bù cháng chī ròu. wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan chī yú.
dialogue.en: I don't often eat meat. I prefer eating fish.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 水果呢？你喜歡什麼水果？
dialogue.py: shuǐ guǒ ne? nǐ xǐ huan shén me shuǐ guǒ?
dialogue.en: What about fruit? What fruit do you like?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我最喜歡蘋果和香蕉。西瓜也不錯。
dialogue.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan píng guǒ hé xiāng jiāo. xī guā yě bù cuò.
dialogue.en: I like apples and bananas the most. Watermelon is also not bad.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我每天都吃一個蘋果。
dialogue.py: wǒ měi tiān dōu chī yī gè píng guǒ.
dialogue.en: I eat an apple every day.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 那很健康！
dialogue.py: nà hěn jiàn kāng!
dialogue.en: That's healthy!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，醫生也是這麼說的。
dialogue.py: duì, yī shēng yě shì zhè me shuō de.
dialogue.en: Yes, the doctor says so too.

key_sentences.en: What do you like to eat most?
I eat an apple every day.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Talk to a friend about dinner. Ask what they like to eat and tell them your favorite fruits and vegetables.

comprehension.q: Does Mark like Chinese food?
What two things does Mark like to eat most?
Does Student A eat a lot of meat?
What kind of meat (animal) does Student A prefer?
How often does Mark eat an apple?

true_false.q: Mark think Chinese food is bad.
Mark eats an apple once a week.
The doctor says eating apples is healthy.

passage.title: Food I Like Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克，你喜歡吃中國菜嗎？非常喜歡。我覺得中國菜很好吃。你最喜歡吃什麼？我最喜歡吃米飯和牛肉。你呢？我喜歡吃麵條，也喜歡吃很多蔬菜。
passage.en: It is lunch time. Students are eating together. They talk about different kinds of food. They ask 'What do you like to eat?'. They talk about fruit, meat, and vegetables.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: List 3 foods you like and 3 foods you dislike in Chinese.

grammar.explanation: Using '比較 (bǐ jiào)' for preference. Using '每天都 (měi tiān dōu)' for daily habits. Adjective '好吃 (hǎo chī)' for food.
examples: 每天都 (Every day - 'dōu' is usually used with 'měi tiān')
我不喜歡吃。 (I don't like to eat.)

practice.q: Complete: 我每天___喝茶。 (I drink tea every day.)
Complete: 你___喜歡吃什麼？ (What do you like most?)

expansion_dialogue.py: wǔ fàn wǒ men chī shén me?
expansion_dialogue.en: What are we eating for lunch?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ men qù chī miàn tiáo ba.
expansion_dialogue.en: Let's go eat noodles.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好，我也想吃麵。再加一個青菜嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo, wǒ yě xiǎng chī miàn. zài jiā yī gè qīng cài ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, I want to eat noodles too. Shall we add a green vegetable?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo de, duō chī shū cài hěn hǎo.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, eating more vegetables is good.

review.writing: Write a list of foods you like and dislike.

title: At the School Cafeteria
story_description: A student buys a simple lunch at the cafeteria.
story_intro: The cafeteria is busy.
A student is standing in line.
He wants to buy some food and a drink.
He asks about the items and prices.
He pays with cash.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想買這個套餐。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng mǎi zhè ge tào cān.
dialogue.en: Hello, I'd like to buy this set meal.

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.zh: 好的。你要飯還是麵？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. nǐ yào fàn hái shì miàn?
dialogue.en: Okay. Do you want rice or noodles?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我要飯，謝謝。
dialogue.py: wǒ yào fàn, xiè xie.
dialogue.en: I want rice, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.zh: 還要別的嗎？
dialogue.py: hái yào bié de ma?
dialogue.en: Anything else?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 還要一碗湯。請問一共多少錢？
dialogue.py: hái yào yī wǎn tāng. qǐng wèn yī gòng duō shǎo qián?
dialogue.en: And a bowl of soup. How much is it in total?

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.zh: 套餐八十塊，湯十五塊，一共九十五塊。
dialogue.py: tào cān bā shí kuài, tāng shí wǔ kuài, yī gòng jiǔ shí wǔ kuài.
dialogue.en: Set meal is 80, soup is 15, total 95 dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 給您一百塊。
dialogue.py: gěi nín yī bǎi kuài.
dialogue.en: Here is 100 dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.zh: 好的。找您五塊錢。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. zhǎo nín wǔ kuài qián.
dialogue.en: Okay. Here is 5 dollars change.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。請問哪裡可以拿餐具？
dialogue.py: xiè xie. qǐng wèn nǎ lǐ kě yǐ ná cān jù?
dialogue.en: Thanks. Where can I get utensils?

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.zh: 就在那邊，桌子上面。
dialogue.py: jiù zài nà biān, zhuō zi shàng miàn.
dialogue.en: Right over there, on top of the table.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，謝謝。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, xiè xie.
dialogue.en: Okay, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。請慢用。
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. qǐng màn yòng.
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Enjoy your meal.

key_sentences.en: I want to buy the set meal.
Do you want rice or noodles?

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are at the cafeteria. Order a set meal with rice and a soup. Ask for the total price and where the utensils are.

comprehension.q: What does Mark want to buy?
Does Mark choose rice or noodles?
What else does Mark order besides the meal?
What is the total cost of the meal and soup?
How much change does the worker give to Mark?

true_false.q: The utensils are on the floor.

passage.title: At the School Cafeteria Listening Passage

examples: 這多少錢？ (How much is this?)

expansion_dialogue.en: Do you want to drink coffee or juice?

title: Drinks and Snacks
story_description: Two friends choose drinks and snacks after school.
story_intro: School is over for the day.
Two friends are hungry and thirsty.
They go to a small shop.
They talk about different snacks and drinks.
They decide what to buy for a break.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你渴嗎？我們去買點喝的吧。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ kě ma? wǒ men qù mǎi diǎn hē de ba.
dialogue.en: Mark, are you thirsty? Let's go buy something to drink.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我也覺得有點渴。
dialogue.py: hǎo a, wǒ yě jué de yǒu diǎn kě.
dialogue.en: Sure, I feel a bit thirsty too.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你想喝什麼？這裡有可樂、果汁和茶。
dialogue.py: nǐ xiǎng hē shén me? zhè lǐ yǒu kě lè, guǒ zhī hé chá.
dialogue.en: What do you want to drink? They have cola, juice, and tea here.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我要一瓶礦泉水。你呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ yào yī píng kuàng quán shuǐ. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: I want a bottle of mineral water. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我要一杯冰紅茶。
dialogue.py: wǒ yào yī bēi bīng hóng chá.
dialogue.en: I want a cup of iced black tea.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你有錢嗎？我也想買點零食。
dialogue.py: nǐ yǒu qián ma? wǒ yě xiǎng mǎi diǎn líng shí.
dialogue.en: Do you have money? I also want to buy some snacks.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 有。你看，那裡的餅乾和巧克力看起來不錯。
dialogue.py: yǒu. nǐ kàn, nà lǐ de bǐng gān hé qiǎo kè lì kàn qǐ lái bù cuò.
dialogue.en: Yes. Look, the cookies and chocolate over there look good.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我不喜歡太甜的東西。我要這包洋芋片。
dialogue.py: wǒ bù xǐ huan tài tián de dōng xi. wǒ yào zhè bāo yáng yù piàn.
dialogue.en: I don't like things that are too sweet. I'll take this bag of potato chips.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 那我要這盒巧克力。
dialogue.py: nà wǒ yào zhè hé qiǎo kè lì.
dialogue.en: Then I'll take this box of chocolate.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我們去付錢吧。
dialogue.py: wǒ men qù fù qián ba.
dialogue.en: Let's go pay.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 好。這是我請你的。
dialogue.py: hǎo. zhè shì wǒ qǐng nǐ de.
dialogue.en: Okay. This is my treat.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！你真客氣。
dialogue.py: xiè xie! nǐ zhēn kè qì.
dialogue.en: Thanks! You're so kind.

key_sentences.en: I also feel a bit thirsty.
What do you want to drink?
I also want to buy some snacks.
I don't like things that are too sweet.

title: At Home
story_description: A student describes their home and rooms to a friend.
story_intro: A student lives in a new house.
He wants to describe it to his friend.
He talks about the different rooms.
He mentions the living room, kitchen, and bedroom.
They talk about what he does in each room.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你搬新家了嗎？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ bān xīn jiā le ma?
dialogue.en: Mark, have you moved to a new home?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，我上個星期搬家了。
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ shàng gè xīng qī bān jiā le.
dialogue.en: Yes, I moved last week.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 新家怎麼樣？大嗎？
dialogue.py: xīn jiā zěn me yàng? dà ma?
dialogue.en: How is the new home? Is it big?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不太大，但是很舒服。有一間客廳和兩間臥室。
dialogue.py: bù tài dà, dàn shì hěn shū fu. yǒu yī jiān kè tīng hé liǎng jiān wò shì.
dialogue.en: Not too big, but very comfortable. It has one living room and two bedrooms.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 有廚房嗎？
dialogue.py: yǒu chú fáng ma?
dialogue.en: Is there a kitchen?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有，廚房雖然小，但是很乾淨。我常在那裡做飯。
dialogue.py: yǒu, chú fáng suī rán xiǎo, dàn shì hěn gān jìng. wǒ cháng zài nà lǐ zuò fàn.
dialogue.en: Yes, although the kitchen is small, it's very clean. I often cook there.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 衛生間在哪裡？
dialogue.py: wèi shēng jiān zài nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: Where is the bathroom?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 衛生間在臥室旁邊。也有一個小陽台。
dialogue.py: wèi shēng jiān zài wò shì páng biān. yě yǒu yī gè xiǎo yáng tái.
dialogue.en: The bathroom is next to the bedroom. There is also a small balcony.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你最喜歡哪個房間？
dialogue.py: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ gè fáng jiān?
dialogue.en: Which room do you like the most?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我最喜歡我的臥室，因為那裡有很大的窗戶。
dialogue.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan wǒ de wò shì, yīn wèi nà lǐ yǒu hěn dà de chuāng hu.
dialogue.en: I like my bedroom the most because there is a very large window.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 聽起來真不錯！下次我去參觀一下。
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái zhēn bù cuò! xià cì wǒ qù cān guān yī xià.
dialogue.en: Sounds really good! I'll go visit next time.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 歡迎！我請你喝茶。
dialogue.py: huān yíng! wǒ qǐng nǐ hē chá.
dialogue.en: Welcome! I'll treat you to some tea.

key_sentences.en: I moved to a new home.
The bathroom is next to the bedroom.
Because there is a large window.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Describe your house to a friend. Mention at least 3 rooms and tell them which one is your favorite and why.
part_c: 你最喜歡家裡的哪個地方？

examples: 雖然小但是乾淨 (Although small but clean)

practice.q: Complete: 我喜歡臥室，___那裡很安靜。 (I like the bedroom because...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.en: We can watch movies together there.

title: My Room
story_description: A student video-calls a friend and shows their room.
story_intro: Mark is at home.
He is talking to a friend on the phone.
He uses the camera to show his bedroom.
He describes the furniture in the room.
He talks about his desk, bed, and lamp.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你現在在臥室嗎？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ xiàn zài zài wò shì ma?
dialogue.en: Mark, are you in your bedroom right now?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，你看，這就是我的房間。
dialogue.py: duì, nǐ kàn, zhè jiù shì wǒ de fáng jiān.
dialogue.en: Yes, look, this is my room.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你的房間很整齊。那是你的床嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ de fáng jiān hěn zhěng qí. nà shì nǐ de chuáng ma?
dialogue.en: Your room is very tidy. Is that your bed?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，床在窗戶下面。床上面有一條毯子。
dialogue.py: duì, chuáng zài chuāng hu xià mian. chuáng shàng miàn yǒu yī tiáo tǎn zi.
dialogue.en: Yes, the bed is under the window. There is a blanket on the bed.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你的書桌在哪裡？
dialogue.py: nǐ de shū zhuō zài nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: Where is your desk?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 書桌在床的旁邊。桌子上面有電腦和一盞檯燈。
dialogue.py: shū zhuō zài chuáng de páng biān. zhuō zi shàng miàn yǒu diàn nǎo hé yī zhǎn tái dēng.
dialogue.en: The desk is next to the bed. On the desk, there is a computer and a lamp.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你有書架嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ yǒu shū jià ma?
dialogue.en: Do you have a bookshelf?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有，書架在門後面。上面有很多中文書。
dialogue.py: yǒu, shū jià zài mén hòu miàn. shàng miàn yǒu hěn duō zhōng wén shū.
dialogue.en: Yes, the bookshelf is behind the door. There are many Chinese books on it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 牆上掛著什麼？
dialogue.py: qiáng shàng guà zhe shén me?
dialogue.en: What is hanging on the wall?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 牆上掛著一張我全家人的照片。
dialogue.py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng wǒ quán jiā rén de zhào piàn.
dialogue.en: Hanging on the wall is a photo of my whole family.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 真溫馨！你的房間採光真好。
dialogue.py: zhēn wēn xīn! nǐ de fáng jiān cǎi guāng zhēn hǎo.
dialogue.en: So warm! Your room has really good lighting.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我非常喜歡待在這裡。
dialogue.py: xiè xie, wǒ fēi cháng xǐ huan dāi zài zhè lǐ.
dialogue.en: Thanks, I really like staying here.

key_sentences.en: The bed is under the window.
The desk is next to the bed.
There is a lamp on the table.
The bookshelf is behind the door.
A photo is hanging on the wall.

title: Where Is My Phone?
story_description: A person cannot find their phone at home. A family member helps.
story_intro: A person is looking for his phone.
He checked the living room and the kitchen.
He asks his mother for help.
They search everywhere.
They use 'in', 'on', 'under', and 'near'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 媽，你看見我的手機了嗎？
dialogue.py: mā, nǐ kàn jiàn wǒ de shǒu jī le ma?
dialogue.en: Mom, have you seen my phone?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 沒看見。你在客廳找過了嗎？
dialogue.py: méi kàn jiàn. nǐ zài kè tīng zhǎo guò le ma?
dialogue.en: I haven't seen it. Have you looked in the living room?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 找過了。沙發上面和下面都沒有。
dialogue.py: zhǎo guò le. shā fā shàng miàn hé xià mian dōu méi yǒu.
dialogue.en: I looked. It's not on or under the sofa.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 會不會在書包裡面？
dialogue.py: huì bù huì zài shū bāo lǐ miàn?
dialogue.en: Could it be inside the schoolbag?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我剛才看了一下，不在裡面。
dialogue.py: wǒ gāng cái kàn le yī xià, bù zài lǐ miàn.
dialogue.en: I just took a look, it's not inside.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 那去廚房看看吧。你在那裡喝過水。
dialogue.py: nà qù chú fáng kàn kàn ba. nǐ zài nà lǐ hē guò shuǐ.
dialogue.en: Then go look in the kitchen. You drank water there.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 喔，對！我去找找看。
dialogue.py: ō, duì! wǒ qù zhǎo zhǎo kàn.
dialogue.en: Oh, right! I'll go have a look.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 不在桌子上，也不在冰箱旁邊。
dialogue.py: bù zài zhuō zi shàng, yě bù zài bīng xiāng páng biān.
dialogue.en: It's not on the table, and not next to the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 你聽！手機響了。
dialogue.py: nǐ tīng! shǒu jī xiǎng le.
dialogue.en: Listen! The phone is ringing.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 是在臥室！啊，找到了！在被子下面。
dialogue.py: shì zài wò shì! ā, zhǎo dào le! zài bèi zi xià mian.
dialogue.en: It's in the bedroom! Ah, found it! Under the quilt.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 下次小心點，別亂放。
dialogue.py: xià cì xiǎo xīn diǎn, bié luàn fàng.
dialogue.en: Be more careful next time, don't just leave it anywhere.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 知道了，謝謝媽。
dialogue.py: zhī dào le, xiè xie mā.
dialogue.en: Got it, thanks Mom.

key_sentences.en: Have you looked in the living room?

vocabulary.meaning: to see / to catch sight of

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You can't find your keys. Ask your mom if she's seen them. Check under the sofa and in the kitchen. She finds them on the table.

passage.zh: 媽，你看見我的手機了嗎？沒看見。你在客廳找過了嗎？找過了。沙發上面和下面都沒有。會不會在書包裡面？我剛才看了一下，不在裡面。

title: Simple Directions in School
story_description: A new student asks where the classroom, bathroom, and office are.
story_intro: A student is new to the school.
She doesn't know where the buildings are.
She asks another student for directions.
They talk about 'left', 'right', 'straight', and 'next to'.
She finds her classroom successfully.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 請問，留學生辦公室在哪裡？
dialogue.py: qǐng wèn, liú xué shēng bàn gōng shì zài nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, where is the international student office?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 在那棟大樓的三樓。
dialogue.py: zài nà dòng dà lóu de sān lóu.
dialogue.en: It's on the third floor of that building.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我要怎麼走？
dialogue.py: wǒ yào zěn me zǒu?
dialogue.en: How do I get there?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 你先往前走，然後往左轉。
dialogue.py: nǐ xiān wǎng qián zǒu, rán hòu wǎng zuǒ zhuǎn.
dialogue.en: First go straight forward, then turn left.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 左轉以後呢？
dialogue.py: zuǒ zhuǎn yǐ hòu ne?
dialogue.en: And after turning left?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 左轉以後，你會看到一個花園。辦公室就在花園旁邊。
dialogue.py: zuǒ zhuǎn yǐ hòu, nǐ huì kàn dào yī gè huā yuán. bàn gōng shì jiù zài huā yuán páng biān.
dialogue.en: After turning left, you'll see a garden. The office is right next to the garden.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 對了，那洗手間呢？
dialogue.py: duì le, nà xǐ shǒu jiān ne?
dialogue.en: By the way, what about the restroom?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 洗手間在走廊盡頭，往右轉就到了。
dialogue.py: xǐ shǒu jiān zài zǒu láng jìn tóu, wǎng yòu zhuǎn jiù dào le.
dialogue.en: The restroom is at the end of the hallway, turn right and you're there.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 圖書館遠嗎？
dialogue.py: tú shū guǎn yuǎn ma?
dialogue.en: Is the library far?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 不遠，就在那棟紅色的建築後面。
dialogue.py: bù yuǎn, jiù zài nà dòng hóng sè de jiàn zhù hòu miàn.
dialogue.en: Not far, it's right behind that red building.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 太謝謝你了！你真熱心。
dialogue.py: tài xiè xie nǐ le! nǐ zhēn rè xīn.
dialogue.en: Thank you so much! You're really helpful.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，祝你順利。
dialogue.py: bù kè qì, zhù nǐ shùn lì.
dialogue.en: You're welcome, good luck.

vocabulary.meaning: how to get there / which way

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are lost in school. Ask a student for the location of the library and the restroom. They give you directions using 'straight', 'left', and 'right'.

comprehension.q: Which floor is the office on?
What is the first direction B gives to A?
Where is the office located relative to the garden?
Where is the restroom?
comprehension.a: At the end of the hallway, turn right

comprehension.q: Is the library far away?

true_false.q: The office is on the first floor.
A needs to turn left at some point.
The restroom is on the second floor.
The library is behind a red building.

passage.title: Simple Directions in School Listening Passage
passage.zh: 請問，留學生辦公室在哪裡？在那棟大樓的三樓。我要怎麼走？你先往前走，然後往左轉。左轉以後呢？
passage.en: A student is new to the school. She doesn't know where the buildings are. She asks another student for directions. They talk about 'left', 'right', 'straight', and 'next to'. She finds her classroom successfully.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write simple directions to your classroom from the school entrance (3-5 sentences).

grammar.explanation: Using '往 (wǎng)' for direction. Using '先 (xiān)...然後 (rán hòu)...' for sequence. Asking '怎麼走 (zěn me zǒu)' for the way.
examples: 先去那裡，然後回來。 (Go there first, then come back.)
圖書館怎麼走？ (How do I get to the library?)

practice.q: Complete: 先左轉，___右轉。 (Turn left first, then turn right.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 請問這棟大樓有電梯嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: qǐng wèn zhè dòng dà lóu yǒu diàn tī ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Excuse me, is there an elevator in this building?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.py: yǒu, diàn tī jiù zài dà mén zuǒ biān.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, the elevator is right to the left of the main entrance.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.py: xiè xie. wǒ yào qù wǔ lóu.
expansion_dialogue.en: Thanks. I'm going to the fifth floor.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.py: méi wèn tí.
expansion_dialogue.en: No problem.

review.speaking: Give simple directions: '往前走，往右轉。'
review.self_check: Can you understand and give basic directions using left, right, and forward?

title: At the Bus Stop
story_description: Two people wait for a bus and ask about the bus number.
story_intro: It is afternoon.
Two people are standing at a bus stop.
They are waiting for different buses.
They ask which bus goes to the train station.
They talk about waiting and schedules.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你好，請問你在等哪路公車？
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, qǐng wèn nǐ zài děng nǎ lù gōng chē?
dialogue.en: Hello, excuse me, which bus are you waiting for?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我在等 105 路。你呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ zài děng yī líng wǔ lù. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: I'm waiting for the 105. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我想去火車站。請問哪路車到火車站？
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng qù huǒ chē zhàn. qǐng wèn nǎ lù chē dào huǒ chē zhàn?
dialogue.en: I want to go to the train station. Which bus goes there?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 212 路和 301 路都到。但是 301 路比較快。
dialogue.py: èr yī èr lù hé sān líng yī lù dōu dào. dàn shì sān líng yī lù bǐ jiào kuài.
dialogue.en: The 212 and 301 both go there. But the 301 is faster.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 301 路要在這裡等嗎？
dialogue.py: sān líng yī lù yào zài zhè lǐ děng ma?
dialogue.en: Do I wait for the 301 here?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 對，就在這裡。你看，公車牌上有寫。
dialogue.py: duì, jiù zài zhè lǐ. nǐ kàn, gōng chē pái shàng yǒu xiě.
dialogue.en: Yes, right here. Look, it's written on the bus stop sign.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 公車大約幾分鐘一班？
dialogue.py: gōng chē dà yuē jǐ fēn zhōng yī bān?
dialogue.en: About every how many minutes does the bus come?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 大約十五分鐘一班。我已經等了十分鐘了。
dialogue.py: dà yuē shí wǔ fēn zhōng yī bān. wǒ yǐ jīng děng le shí fēn zhōng le.
dialogue.en: About every fifteen minutes. I've already been waiting for ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 喔，那公車快要來了。
dialogue.py: ō, nà gōng chē kuài yào lái le.
dialogue.en: Oh, then the bus is coming soon.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 看，那邊有一輛車過來了。那是 301 路嗎？
dialogue.py: kàn, nà biān yǒu yī liàng chē guò lái le. nà shì sān líng yī lù ma?
dialogue.en: Look, a bus is coming over there. Is that the 301?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我看看...對，是 301 路！
dialogue.py: wǒ kàn kàn... duì, shì sān líng yī lù!
dialogue.en: Let me see... yes, it's the 301!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 太好了，你上車吧。再見！
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le, nǐ shàng chē ba. zài jiàn!
dialogue.en: Great, get on the bus. Goodbye!

key_sentences.en: Which bus are you waiting for?
I want to go to the train station.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are at a bus stop. Ask a stranger if the bus to the airport stops here and how often it comes. They tell you it's the 100 bus, every 20 minutes.

comprehension.q: Which bus is B waiting for?
Where does A want to go?
Which two buses go to the train station?
Which bus is faster?
How long has B been waiting?

true_false.q: The 105 bus goes to the train station.
A needs to wait at this stop for the 301.
A bus is coming at the end of the dialogue.

passage.title: At the Bus Stop Listening Passage
passage.zh: 你好，請問你在等哪路公車？我在等105路。你呢？我想去火車站。請問哪路車到火車站？212路和301路都到。但是301路比較快。301路要在這裡等嗎？
passage.en: It is afternoon. Two people are standing at a bus stop. They are waiting for different buses. They ask which bus goes to the train station. They talk about waiting and schedules.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a short question asking which bus to take to a specific place (e.g., 'Does the 202 bus go to the library?').

grammar.explanation: Using '路 (lù)' for bus numbers. Using '輛 (liàng)' as a measure word for vehicles. Duration of time: 'Verb + 了 + Time' (e.g., '等了十分鐘').
examples: 等了半小時 (Waited for half an hour)
上車 / 下車 (Get on / get off)

practice.q: Complete: 公車快要___了。 (The bus is about to come.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè liàng chē qù jī chǎng ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Does this vehicle go to the airport?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.py: bù qù. nǐ yào zuò dì tiě qù.
expansion_dialogue.en: No. You need to take the subway.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.py: dì tiě zhàn zài nǎ lǐ?
expansion_dialogue.en: Where is the subway station?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.py: jiù zài qián miàn, zǒu lù liǎng fēn zhōng.
expansion_dialogue.en: It's right ahead, a two-minute walk.

review.speaking: Ask which bus to take to the station.
review.writing: Write: '我想去火車站，坐哪路公車？'
review.self_check: Can you ask about bus numbers and understand how long to wait?

title: My Daily Morning
story_description: A student talks about what they do every morning.
story_intro: The sun comes up.
A student wakes up early.
He has a busy morning routine.
He talks about brushing teeth and eating breakfast.
He gets ready for school.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你每天早上幾點起床？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ měi tiān zǎo shang jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng?
dialogue.en: Mark, what time do you get up every morning?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我通常六點半起床。
dialogue.py: wǒ tōng cháng liù diǎn bàn qǐ chuáng.
dialogue.en: I usually get up at 6:30.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 那麼早！你起床以後做什麼？
dialogue.py: nà me zǎo! nǐ qǐ chuáng yǐ hòu zuò shén me?
dialogue.en: So early! What do you do after getting up?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我先刷牙、洗臉，然後去跑步。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiān shuā yá, xǐ liǎn, rán hòu qù pǎo bù.
dialogue.en: First I brush my teeth and wash my face, then I go for a run.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你每天都運動嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ měi tiān dōu yùn dòng ma?
dialogue.en: Do you exercise every day?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，跑步讓我很有精神。七點半我吃早飯。
dialogue.py: duì, pǎo bù ràng wǒ hěn yǒu jīng shén. qī diǎn bàn wǒ chī zǎo fàn.
dialogue.en: Yes, running gives me energy. At 7:30 I eat breakfast.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你早飯吃什麼？
dialogue.py: nǐ zǎo fàn chī shén me?
dialogue.en: What do you eat for breakfast?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我常吃雞蛋和麵包，喝一杯牛奶。
dialogue.py: wǒ cháng chī jī dàn hé miàn bāo, hē yī bēi niú nǎi.
dialogue.en: I often eat eggs and bread, and drink a cup of milk.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你幾點去學校？
dialogue.py: nǐ jǐ diǎn qù xué xiào?
dialogue.en: What time do you go to school?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我八點出門，坐公車去學校。
dialogue.py: wǒ bā diǎn chū mén, zuò gōng chē qù xué xiào.
dialogue.en: I leave the house at 8:00 and take the bus to school.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你的早晨很充實。
dialogue.py: nǐ de zǎo chén hěn chōng shí.
dialogue.en: Your morning is very productive.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，早起很有好處。
dialogue.py: duì, zǎo qǐ hěn yǒu hǎo chu.
dialogue.en: Yes, getting up early has many benefits.

key_sentences.en: What time do you get up?
What do you do after getting up?
I first brush teeth, wash face.

vocabulary.meaning: to get up / to wake up
to go out / leave the house

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Tell a friend your morning routine. Mention what time you wake up, two things you do to get ready, and what you eat for breakfast.

comprehension.q: What time does Mark wake up?
What are the first two things Mark does after waking up?
Why does Mark like running?
What does Mark have for breakfast?
How does Mark get to school?

true_false.q: Mark drinks coffee in the morning.
A thinks Mark's morning is productive.

passage.title: My Daily Morning Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克，你每天早上幾點起床？我通常六點半起床。那麼早！你起床以後做什麼？我先刷牙、洗臉，然後去跑步。你每天都運動嗎？
passage.en: The sun comes up. A student wakes up early. He has a busy morning routine. He talks about brushing teeth and eating breakfast. He gets ready for school.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write 5 sentences about your morning routine in Chinese.

grammar.explanation: Using '...以後 (yǐ hòu)' for 'after ...'. Using '讓 (ràng)' for 'to make/cause someone to ...'. Using '通常 (tōng cháng)' for 'usually'.
examples: 這件事讓我很高興。 (This thing makes me very happy.)
我通常十點睡覺。 (I usually go to bed at 10:00.)

practice.q: Complete: 運動___我很健康。 (Exercise makes me healthy.)
Translate: I usually get up at 7:00.
Complete: 我___刷牙，然後洗澡。 (I brush teeth first...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你早上洗澡還是晚上洗澡？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ zǎo shang xǐ zǎo hái shì wǎn shang xǐ zǎo?
expansion_dialogue.en: Do you shower in the morning or at night?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ tōng cháng wǎn shang xǐ zǎo.
expansion_dialogue.en: I usually shower at night.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.py: wèi shén me?
expansion_dialogue.en: Why?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 因為洗澡讓我放鬆，容易睡覺。
expansion_dialogue.py: yīn wèi xǐ zǎo ràng wǒ fàng sōng, róng yì shuì jiào.
expansion_dialogue.en: Because showering relaxes me and makes it easy to sleep.

review.speaking: Say your morning routine in 3 sentences.
review.self_check: Can you describe your daily morning actions in sequence?

title: After School
story_description: Two classmates discuss what they do after school.
story_intro: The school bell rings.
Classes are finished for today.
Two friends walk out of the school gate.
They talk about their plans for the evening.
They mention studying, resting, and eating dinner.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，放學了！你等一下要做什麼？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, fàng xué le! nǐ děng yī xià yào zuò shén me?
dialogue.en: Mark, school's out! What are you going to do in a bit?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我先回家休息一下，然後做功課。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiān huí jiā xiū xi yī xià, rán hòu zuò gōng kè.
dialogue.en: I'll go home and rest for a bit first, then do homework.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你每天放學都直接回家嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ měi tiān fàng xué dōu zhí jiē huí jiā ma?
dialogue.en: Do you go straight home after school every day?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不一定。有時候我會去超市買點東西。
dialogue.py: bù yī dìng. yǒu shí hou wǒ huì qù chāo shì mǎi diǎn dōng xi.
dialogue.en: Not necessarily. Sometimes I'll go to the supermarket to buy some things.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你幾點吃晚飯？
dialogue.py: nǐ jǐ diǎn chī wǎn fàn?
dialogue.en: What time do you eat dinner?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我通常七點和全家人一起吃晚飯。
dialogue.py: wǒ tōng cháng qī diǎn hé quán jiā rén yī qǐ chī wǎn fàn.
dialogue.en: I usually eat dinner with my whole family at 7:00.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 晚飯後你做什麼？
dialogue.py: wǎn fàn hòu nǐ zuò shén me?
dialogue.en: What do you do after dinner?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 晚飯後我喜歡看一會兒電視，或者上網。
dialogue.py: wǎn fàn hòu wǒ xǐ huan kàn yī huì r diàn shì, huò zhě shàng wǎng.
dialogue.en: After dinner I like to watch TV for a while, or go online.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你幾點睡覺？
dialogue.py: nǐ jǐ diǎn shuì jiào?
dialogue.en: What time do you go to bed?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我十一點左右睡覺。你呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ shí yī diǎn zuǒ yòu shuì jiào. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: I go to bed around 11:00. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我睡得比較早，十點就睡了。
dialogue.py: wǒ shuì de bǐ jiào zǎo, shí diǎn jiù shuì le.
dialogue.en: I sleep relatively early, I'm asleep by 10:00.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 早點睡覺對身體好。明天見！
dialogue.py: zǎo diǎn shuì jiào duì shēn tǐ hǎo. míng tiān jiàn!
dialogue.en: Sleeping early is good for the body. See you tomorrow!

key_sentences.en: Go home and rest a bit.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Talk to your classmate after school. Ask what they are going to do tonight and what time they usually sleep. Tell them your plan.

comprehension.q: What will Mark do immediately after school?
comprehension.a: Go home and rest for a bit

comprehension.q: Does Mark always go straight home?
comprehension.a: No, sometimes he goes to the supermarket

comprehension.q: Who does Mark eat dinner with?
What are the two activities Mark might do after dinner?
Who sleeps earlier, A or Mark?

true_false.q: Mark goes to bed at 11:00 PM exactly.
Mark thinks sleeping early is good.

passage.title: After School Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克，放學了！你等一下要做什麼？我先回家休息一下，然後做功課。你每天放學都直接回家嗎？不一定。有時候我會去超市買點東西。你幾點吃晚飯？
passage.en: The school bell rings. Classes are finished for today. Two friends walk out of the school gate. They talk about their plans for the evening. They mention studying, resting, and eating dinner.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write your after-school routine (3-5 sentences).

grammar.explanation: Using '左右 (zuǒ yòu)' after a time or number to mean 'around'. Using '就 (jiù)' to emphasize that something happened early or quickly. '一下' for a short duration.
examples: 我九點就到了。 (I arrived as early as 9:00.)
看一會兒 (Watch for a while)

practice.q: Complete: 我六點___起床了。 (I got up as early as 6:00.)
Complete: 我___時候看書。 (I sometimes read books.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.py: zhōu mò nǐ yǒu shén me dǎ suàn?
expansion_dialogue.en: What are your plans for the weekend?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ dǎ suàn qù pá shān. nǐ ne?
expansion_dialogue.en: I plan to go hiking. How about you?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我想在家看書，放鬆一下。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng zài jiā kàn shū, fàng sōng yī xià.
expansion_dialogue.en: I want to stay home and read books, relax a bit.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái yě hěn shū fu.
expansion_dialogue.en: Sounds very comfortable too.

review.speaking: Describe your evening routine.
review.self_check: Can you say what you do in the evening and what time you sleep?

title: I Can and I Can’t
story_description: Students talk about simple abilities: swim, cook, draw, sing.
story_intro: The students are talking about hobbies.
They talk about what they can do.
They use the word 'can' and 'can't'.
They mention sports, music, and art.
They find out they have many skills.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你會游泳嗎？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ huì yóu yǒng ma?
dialogue.en: Mark, can you swim?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 會，我非常喜歡游泳。你呢？
dialogue.py: huì, wǒ fēi cháng xǐ huan yóu yǒng. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: Yes, I really like swimming. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我不會游泳，但是我會打網球。
dialogue.py: wǒ bù huì yóu yǒng, dàn shì wǒ huì dǎ wǎng qiú.
dialogue.en: I can't swim, but I can play tennis.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 網球很難學，你真厲害！你會唱歌嗎？
dialogue.py: wǎng qiú hěn nán xué, nǐ zhēn lì hai! nǐ huì chàng gē ma?
dialogue.en: Tennis is hard to learn, you're really great! Can you sing?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我唱歌唱得不好。你會彈鋼琴嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ chàng gē chàng de bù hǎo. nǐ huì tán gāng qín ma?
dialogue.en: I don't sing well. Can you play the piano?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不會，但是我會拉小提琴。我也會一點兒畫畫。
dialogue.py: bù huì, dàn shì wǒ huì lā xiǎo tí qín. wǒ yě huì yī diǎn r huà huà.
dialogue.en: No, but I can play the violin. I can also draw a little.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你會做飯嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ huì zuò fàn ma?
dialogue.en: Can you cook?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我會做簡單的中國菜。我媽媽教過我。
dialogue.py: wǒ huì zuò jiǎn dān de zhōng guó cài. wǒ mā ma jiāo guò wǒ.
dialogue.en: I can cook simple Chinese dishes. My mom taught me.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！我也想學做飯。
dialogue.py: tài bàng le! wǒ yě xiǎng xué zuò fàn.
dialogue.en: Excellent! I also want to learn to cook.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我可以教你。你會開車嗎？
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí, wǒ kě yǐ jiāo nǐ. nǐ huì kāi chē ma?
dialogue.en: No problem, I can teach you. Can you drive?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我會開車，但是我不常開。
dialogue.py: wǒ huì kāi chē, dàn shì wǒ bù cháng kāi.
dialogue.en: I can drive, but I don't drive often.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 原來大家都會很多東西！

title: My Favorite Animal
story_description: Students talk about animals they like and dislike.
story_intro: The students are at the zoo (in their imagination).
They look at pictures of animals.
They talk about dogs, cats, pandas, and tigers.
They use adjectives like 'big', 'small', and 'cute'.
They discuss having pets at home.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你喜歡小動物嗎？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ xǐ huan xiǎo dòng wù ma?
dialogue.en: Mark, do you like small animals?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 喜歡，我最喜歡狗。你呢？
dialogue.py: xǐ huan, wǒ zuì xǐ huan gǒu. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: Yes, I like dogs the most. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我比較喜歡貓。我覺得貓很可愛。
dialogue.py: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan māo. wǒ jué de māo hěn kě ài.
dialogue.en: I prefer cats. I think cats are very cute.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 貓確實很可愛，但是貓有點兒高冷。
dialogue.py: māo què shí hěn kě ài, dàn shì māo yǒu diǎn r gāo lěng.
dialogue.en: Cats are indeed cute, but they're a bit aloof.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你看，這張照片裡的熊貓多可愛啊！
dialogue.py: nǐ kàn, zhè zhāng zhào piàn lǐ de xióng māo duō kě ài a!
dialogue.en: Look, how cute the panda in this photo is!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，熊貓是中國的國寶。牠們胖胖的。
dialogue.py: duì, xióng māo shì zhōng guó de guó bǎo. tā men pàng pàng de.
dialogue.en: Yes, pandas are China's national treasure. They are chubby.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你怕不怕大動物？比如老虎或者獅子。
dialogue.py: nǐ pà bù pà dà dòng wù? bǐ rú lǎo hǔ huò zhě shī zi.
dialogue.en: Are you afraid of big animals? Like tigers or lions.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有點兒怕，因為牠們很兇，而且很大。
dialogue.py: yǒu diǎn r pà, yīn wèi tā men hěn xiōng, ér qiě hěn dà.
dialogue.en: A bit afraid, because they are fierce and also very big.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我也不喜歡太兇的動物。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě bù xǐ huan tài xiōng de dòng wù.
dialogue.en: I don't like animals that are too fierce either.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你家裡有寵物嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ jiā lǐ yǒu chǒng wù ma?
dialogue.en: Do you have pets at home?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 有，我有一隻小兔子。
dialogue.py: yǒu, wǒ yǒu yī zhī xiǎo tù zi.
dialogue.en: Yes, I have a little rabbit.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 兔子很漂亮，耳朵長長的。
dialogue.py: tù zi hěn piào liang, ěr duo cháng cháng de.
dialogue.en: Rabbits are beautiful, with long ears.

title: The Weather Today
story_description: Two friends decide what to wear based on the weather.
story_intro: Mark is looking out the window.
It is a new day.
He talks to a friend about the weather.
They talk about 'sunny', 'rainy', 'hot', and 'cold'.
They decide what to do and what to wear.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，今天天氣怎麼樣？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, jīn tiān tiān qì zěn me yàng?
dialogue.en: Mark, how is the weather today?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 今天天氣很好，晴天，而且很暖和。
dialogue.py: jīn tiān tiān qì hěn hǎo, qíng tiān, ér qiě hěn nuǎn huo.
dialogue.en: The weather is good today, sunny, and very warm.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我想下午去公園散步。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le! wǒ xiǎng xià wǔ qù gōng yuán sàn bù.
dialogue.en: Great! I want to go for a walk in the park this afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 但是我看天氣預報，傍晚可能會有雨。
dialogue.py: dàn shì wǒ kàn tiān qì yù bào, bàng wǎn kě néng huì yǒu yǔ.
dialogue.en: But I saw the weather forecast, there might be rain in the evening.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那我要帶把傘嗎？
dialogue.py: zhēn de ma? nà wǒ yào dài bǎ sǎn ma?
dialogue.en: Really? Then should I bring an umbrella?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 帶一把吧，以防萬一。
dialogue.py: dài yī bǎ ba, yǐ fáng wàn yī.
dialogue.en: Bring one, just in case.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 現在外面熱不熱？
dialogue.py: xiàn zài wài miàn rè bù rè?
dialogue.en: Is it hot outside right now?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不熱，但是有點兒風。你穿一件薄外套吧。
dialogue.py: bù rè, dàn shì yǒu diǎn r fēng. nǐ chuān yī jiàn báo wài tào ba.
dialogue.en: Not hot, but there's a bit of wind. Wear a thin jacket.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 好的。明天的天氣呢？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. míng tiān de tiān qì ne?
dialogue.en: Okay. What about tomorrow's weather?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 明天會降溫，變得很冷。
dialogue.py: míng tiān huì jiàng wēn, biàn de hěn lěng.
dialogue.en: The temperature will drop tomorrow, it will become very cold.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 喔，那我明天得穿毛衣了。
dialogue.py: ō, nà wǒ míng tiān děi chuān máo yī le.
dialogue.en: Oh, then I'll have to wear a sweater tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，要注意保暖。
dialogue.py: duì, yào zhù yì bǎo nuǎn.
dialogue.en: Yes, pay attention to keeping warm.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Your friend wants to go to the park. Check the weather forecast and advise them on what to bring or wear (umbrella, coat, etc.).

title: Review Story: A New Student’s First Week
story_description: A new student introduces themselves, finds the classroom, talks about family, food, and routine.
story_intro: It is the end of the first week.
Mark is writing a letter to his parents.
He tells them about his new school.
He mentions his new friends and his room.
He talks about his daily life and the weather.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 爸爸、媽媽，你們好嗎？
dialogue.py: bà ba, mā ma, nǐ men hǎo ma?
dialogue.en: Dad, Mom, how are you?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我在這裏很好。我的新房間很舒服。
dialogue.py: wǒ zài zhè lǐ hěn hǎo. wǒ de xīn fáng jiān hěn shū fu.
dialogue.en: I'm doing well here. My new room is very comfortable.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我認識了一個新朋友，他叫大衛。
dialogue.py: wǒ rèn shi le yī gè xīn péng you, tā jiào dà wèi.
dialogue.en: I've met a new friend named David.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛是加拿大人，他非常聰明。
dialogue.py: dà wèi shì jiā ná dà rén, tā fēi cháng cōng ming.
dialogue.en: David is Canadian; he is very smart.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我們每天一起上課、吃午飯。
dialogue.py: wǒ men měi tiān yī qǐ shàng kè, chī wǔ fàn.
dialogue.en: We attend class and eat lunch together every day.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 學校的中國菜很好吃，我最喜歡吃牛肉。
dialogue.py: xué xiào de zhōng guó cài hěn hǎo chī, wǒ zuì xǐ huan chī niú ròu.
dialogue.en: The school's Chinese food is delicious; I like eating beef the most.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 今天的天氣很好，是晴天。
dialogue.py: jīn tiān de tiān qì hěn hǎo, shì qíng tiān.
dialogue.en: The weather today is good; it's a sunny day.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我學會了說一點兒中文了。
dialogue.py: wǒ xué huì le shuō yī diǎn r zhōng wén le.
dialogue.en: I've learned to speak a little Chinese now.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我現在會介紹我的家人，還會問路。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiàn zài huì jiè shào wǒ de jiā rén, hái huì wèn lù.
dialogue.en: I can now introduce my family and also ask for directions.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 雖然學中文有點兒難，但是很有意思。
dialogue.py: suī rán xué zhōng wén yǒu diǎn r nán, dàn shì hěn yǒu yì si.
dialogue.en: Although learning Chinese is a bit hard, it's very interesting.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我想你們。祝你們身體健康！
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng nǐ men. zhù nǐ men shēn tǐ jiàn kāng!
dialogue.en: I miss you. Wish you good health!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 愛您的，馬克。
dialogue.py: ài nín de, mǎ kè.
dialogue.en: Love, Mark.
